description: This is the Cover Plate which provides structural support and sealing for the centrifugal pump's front section, maintaining internal pressure and preventing leakage.
This is the Discharge Nozzle that directs fluid flow out of the pump, converting velocity into pressure, and facilitating efficient fluid transfer.
This is the Impeller which rotates to generate centrifugal force, accelerating fluid flow and increasing pressure within the pump for efficient fluid transfer.
This is the Pipe Extension that connects to the discharge nozzle, providing a conduit for fluid flow and facilitating system integration and piping connections.
This is the Shaft that transmits rotational motion from the pump's driver to the impeller, enabling mechanical energy conversion and fluid flow generation.
